# Tools that write and check the release SBOM. Pinned so a release does not
# change with the newest Pitloom; the workflows pass this file to pip as a
# constraint (PIP_CONSTRAINT), which reaches the isolated build too. The
# `>=` floor in pyproject.toml stays, for users who build from the sdist.
# Pitloom 0.21 imports licenseid's 0.6 names (`resolve`,
# `AggregatedLicenseMatcher`); 0.21.2 requires `licenseid<0.7`. Its licenseid
# stays at 0.6 until a Pitloom release reads the 0.7 names; then raise both
# pins together.
licenseid==0.6.0
magika==1.0.3
pitloom==0.21.2
spdx3-validate==0.0.7
